meta.name: first-touch
meta.description: Writes first cold emails for B2B outbound campaigns. Use when the user asks to "write a cold email", "draft an outreach email", "create a first touch", "email 1", "initial email", "opening email", "first email in sequence", or needs help choosing a cold email framework. Also triggers on "cold email copy", "outbound email template", "how to start a cold email". Do NOT use for follow-up emails, re-engagement emails, subject lines only, or deliverability/infrastructure questions.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 写出可一键发送的B2B冷邮件
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果你经常需要为B2B业务撰写冷邮件，但缺乏时间或模板
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you frequently need to write cold emails for B2B outreach but lack time or templates

howto.what: Claude会撰写B2B外展的首次冷邮件。每封邮件60-90词，纯文本，一个行动号召，以痛点开头。
howto.when: 当你要求撰写冷邮件（如“write a cold email”、“create a first touch”等），或需要选择冷邮件框架时触发。不用于跟进邮件或仅主题行。

say.text: 帮我写一封B2B冷邮件，使用Do the Math框架，针对招聘平台。
say.note: Claude会按框架生成邮件，包含痛点、计算和行动号召。

howto.what_en: Claude writes first cold emails for B2B outbound campaigns. Emails are 60-90 words, plain text, one CTA, and lead with pain over features.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you ask to write a cold email, create a first touch, choose a cold email framework, or say 'cold email copy', 'outbound email template', etc. Not for follow-ups or subject lines only.

say_en.text: Write a B2B cold email using the Do the Math framework for a hiring platform.
say_en.note: Claude will generate the email with pain point, calculation, and CTA.

say_en.text: Create a first touch email with the Challenge of Similar Companies framework.
say_en.note: Claude will ask about the target company and draft accordingly.
